timeline.summary: On May 14, 2026, Sigachi Industries filed its monitoring agency report for Q4 FY26, showing ₹57.40 Cr unutilized IPO proceeds.
Amit Raj Sinha, Promoter, declared no new pledge or encumbrance on Sigachi Industries shares as of April 06, 2026, beyond prior disclosures.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹121.9 Cr (-4.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹7.71 Cr (-41.9% YoY).
Sigachi Industries issued its Q4 FY26 investor presentation outlining FY27 guidance of ₹650–675 Cr revenue and 18–20% EBITDA margin.
Sigachi Industries Limited shared Q4 FY 2025-26 earnings call recording on its website via **Vivek Kumar**, signed digitally.
On June 5, 2026, Sigachi Industries filed the transcript of its Q4 FY26 earnings call held on May 30, 2026.
Sigachi Industries held Q1FY27 earnings call on August 13, 2026, reaffirming FY27 revenue guidance of ₹650-675 Cr with 18% EBITDA margin target, while reporting Q1 revenue of ₹121.27 Cr
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹130.46 Cr (+18.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹10.18 Cr (-4.8% YoY).
Sigachi Industries reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹130.5 Cr and an improved EBITDA margin of 14.7%.
Audio recording of Q2 FY 2026-27 Earnings Call made available on company website on 31 October 2026.
